about.title: An association born|of a simple gesture
about.lead: 1001 SADAQA is a humanitarian and social association based in Cotonou, Benin, working for vulnerable people. The association turns acts of generosity into concrete action to help those who need it most.
about.missionBody: The primary goal of 1001 SADAQA is to bring about lasting improvement in the living conditions of vulnerable people, through social and humanitarian programmes with real impact.
about.commitmentBody: 1001 SADAQA acts in the conviction that generosity and solidarity are universal values, able to change the lives of the most vulnerable for good.

history.title: Our story
history.body: 1001 SADAQA is a non-governmental organisation founded in Cotonou in 2026, following several solidarity initiatives run since 2024. It was born of a realisation in the field: one-off acts of solidarity, however precious, are not enough to change lives for good. Handing out a meal or providing care relieves immediate distress, but it does not answer what people most deeply want - to regain their dignity, to get an education, to build economic independence. That is why we designed an integrated model that supports each person along a structured path: from emergency aid to empowerment, and on to a lasting way out of hardship.
history.nameBody: The word sadaqa carries an idea of voluntary giving, of generosity, of action carried out for the benefit of others. Our organisation draws on that inspiration while giving it a resolutely universal reach: it is open to all and acts for all, without distinction of origin, culture or social condition. The number 1001 expresses the many ways there are to act - offering a meal, giving time, sharing a skill, supporting a child, easing access to care, helping a woman towards independence, providing access to water, mobilising a company, or simply reaching out a hand.

about.visionBody: To build a world where solidarity becomes a true engine of social change, dignity and self-reliance.

values.title: What guides|everything we do
values.lead: Five values, and one philosophy of action that sums them up.

dignity.title: Human dignity
dignity.body: Every beneficiary is supported with respect, attention and care.

universality.title: Universality
universality.body: Our work is open to all, without distinction of origin, culture or social condition.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.body: We manage resources rigorously and keep our interventions traceable.

equity.title: Equity
equity.body: We give priority attention to the most vulnerable people.

innovation.title: Social innovation
innovation.body: We develop solutions suited to local realities and aimed at lasting impact.

values.philosophyBody: Our approach rests on one conviction: aid must not only meet immediate needs, it must create the conditions for lasting independence. Our model follows a step-by-step path - protect, feed, care, empower.

governance.title: A structured organisation,|transparent and accountable
governance.lead: The governance of 1001 SADAQA rests on a clear structure ensuring effective decision-making, transparent management of resources and rigorous delivery of programmes. It relies on four complementary levels.

assembly.title: General assembly
assembly.body: The organisation's sovereign body: it sets strategic direction, approves activity and financial reports, and elects the members of the board.

board.title: Board of directors
board.body: The strategic steering body: it oversees management, approves programmes and budgets, and ensures the mission and values are upheld.

executive.title: Executive office
executive.body: Responsible for operational delivery: a president, a vice-president, a general secretary and a treasurer. It coordinates activities, handles day-to-day management and follows up partnerships.

committees.title: Technical committees
committees.body: Specialist committees safeguard the quality of our work: community health, nutrition and food security, social protection, education and empowerment, emergency response.

traceability.title: Traceability
traceability.body: Every gift, financial or in kind, is recorded and used solely for the organisation's purposes.

control.title: Oversight
control.body: Management is monitored by the board and verified by external audits.

reporting.title: Reporting
reporting.body: Annual reports detail activities, results and the use of funds, and are shared with funders and partners.

strategy.title: The course|for the next five years
strategy.lead: Through its 2026 - 2030 strategic vision, 1001 SADAQA aims to build a form of solidarity that does not stop at meeting today's needs, but gives communities the means to build their own future.

programs.title: Extend and structure the programmes
programs.body: Grow the food bank, extend the water, hygiene and sanitation programmes, and give structure to social protection.

organisation.title: Consolidate a professional organisation
organisation.body: Strengthen governance, ensure accountability through digital monitoring tools, and diversify funding.

autonomy.title: Develop lasting empowerment
autonomy.body: Roll out the economic empowerment programmes, strengthen impact measurement, and promote an African model of lasting solidarity.

structure.title: Structure
structure.body: Consolidate internal organisation, formalise the programmes, launch the priority pilot projects, strengthen monitoring tools and bring in the first structuring partners.

deploy.title: Deploy
deploy.body: Extend operations to several areas of Benin, grow the food bank, strengthen the social, food, health and WASH programmes, roll out the Empowerment programme.

transform.title: Transform
transform.body: Consolidate the programmes that have proved their worth, document and evaluate impact, develop a replicable model and prepare for expansion across West Africa.
